title.narrative: Forum des Femmes pour la gouvernance des ressources naturelles

description.narrative: FFGRN engages in the fight for good governance in the management of natural resources at the intersection of women's rights, the environment and climate justice.This grant also supports:- Support in sewing equipment (overlocking machine) to boost the empowerment of women and girls, increase their income, be more independent and thus have the necessary capacities for the development of female entrepreneurship);- Capacity building of members on accounting management tools and reporting;- Support for the harmonization of the statutes of mining cooperatives with the new mining legislation;- The development of the financial regulations of the FFGRN
